SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TIMESEQ, SEQ, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE FROM PLDELIVDMROT_KEP WHERE LEGJOBFLAG = '400' AND STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY TIMESEQ, SEQ, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'IV' AS DOC_TYPE, 'STX2' AS BUYER, DELIV_NO AS KEY_NO, DELIV_SEQ AS KEY_SEQ, PO_NO AS DATA01, PO_SEQ AS DATA02, DELIV_NO AS DATA03 FROM PLDELIVDMROT_KEP WHERE TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$'
UPDATE PLDELIVDMROT_KEP SET LEGJOBFLAG = '500' WHERE TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$'
